column1: # Third-party images that go into each offline release bundle: images an
# install runs that are not built by any Ignite Ember repository. Read by
# the `offline-bundle` job in .github/workflows/cd.yml.
# Postgres is here for the chart's backup CronJob (`pg_dump`), which takes
# its image from beside image.repository: registry.example.com/igni/igni-api
# gives registry.example.com/igni/postgres:<tag>. Without it in the bundle,
# an air-gapped install that turned backups on pulled from Docker Hub, or
# failed to (B38). The chart deploys no database, so this is the client
# only; keep the tag the chart's `backup.image.tag`.
# Pinned by digest: the upstream tag can move, and what is reviewed here is
# the digest. CD copies it to ghcr.io/ignite-ember/<name>:<tag> with that
# digest preserved, refuses if GHCR stores another, and signs and attests
# it with the release key like every other image in the bundle. Bumping
# one is a line in a pull request:
#   skopeo inspect --raw docker://docker.io/library/postgres:<tag> | sha256sum
# (the raw manifest: the image index, not one platform's entry).
# Columns, separated by whitespace:
#   name     — on GHCR (ghcr.io/ignite-ember/<name>), in the bundle and in
#              the customer's registry: one name everywhere
#   upstream — where it is copied from, pinned by digest
#   tag      — the tag it carries on GHCR, in the bundle and after import
postgres  docker.io/library/postgres@sha256:ef257d85f76e48da1c64832459b59fcaba1a4dac97bf5d7450c77753542eee94  17.6-alpine
